scope: Static context/menu factorial with identical literal question and raw equation inputs; raw-state results are diagnostic, not live candidates.

protocol.order_policy: Shuffle cases; rotate four condition request orders evenly across cases, reverse cases and condition order for repetition two. Match physical option order across all four conditions within each case/repetition; cycle five angle orders and separately rotate opaque-ID assignments.
protocol.scope: Fresh static 2x2 comparison of full observation versus only raw x/y, crossed with semantic-physical versus opaque-numeric menus. Identical literal question, no locator, no internal-mechanism or driving qualification claim.
protocol.representation_contract: All four conditions encode the same five angles and raw x/y equation inputs. Shared factual wrapper and literal question omit TARGET_LOCATOR. Full state includes the original telemetry and named raw coordinates; raw state is exactly{x,y}. Numeric-menu IDs rotate across angles, matched across both state conditions. No current-query calculation or recommendation is supplied.
protocol.followup_policy: Only a passing full-state strong-gain gate may trigger separately frozen fresh native-menu static validation of up to 192 calls. If the gate fails, finish the comparison without extra paid calls. No automatic race or preset promotion.
protocol.factorial_main_effects: State effect mean(B-A,D-C); menu effect mean(C-A,D-B). Report interaction. Descriptive matched comparisons, no independent-sample significance claim.
protocol.live_eligibility: Only full_numeric is a full-state candidate here. Raw-state performance is diagnostic: speed/recovery/progress facts were removed. Any raw-state gain must transfer to a fresh all-facts-preserved representation before live qualification.

factorial_effects.scope: Descriptive matched differences; neither independent-sample significance nor an internal causal mechanism is identified.

limitations: Twenty-four fresh synthetic geometries in twelve mirrored pairs and repeated conditions are not independent driving trials.
The context factor changes telemetry content, amount and length together. Its effect cannot distinguish attention load from competing driving facts or other context mechanisms.
The menu factor changes meaningful versus opaque IDs and physical versus numeric descriptions together. This phase does not separate those menu components or identify an internal bias mechanism.

The same explicit literal question and raw equation inputs are present in all contexts. Removing unrelated telemetry preserves this mathematical task's inputs, not the recovery, gate and speed information required for live driving.
Raw-state results are diagnostic only. A raw-only gain cannot qualify a live driver; a separate variant preserving full factual information must be evaluated before live validation.

The shared target-locator paragraph used in earlier studies is absent everywhere in this comparison. Fresh fixtures and changed shared wording prevent a paired interpretation of cross-study score differences.
Physical angle insertion order is matched across conditions and nearly counterbalanced across units. Submitted wire order does not prove the provider exposes that order internally.
Repeated requests can use different opaque ID-to-angle assignments and insertion orders; repeat agreement compares physical angles, not answer-ID strings.
No worked examples or current-query arithmetic are supplied. Coarse wheel answers cannot prove exact trigonometry, optimal driving or closed-loop reliability.
Heading-sign mismatch groups can differ in target magnitude; subgroup scores do not isolate a sign-conflict effect.
Endpoint errors count as incorrect in attempted accuracy; planned coverage and unrun cases remain separate.
recommendation: Retain full factual telemetry and damped live baseline. Raw-state gains on full targets trade away straight-target accuracy; the sole eligible full_numeric candidate fails the gate. Test a separately frozen division-free algebraic presentation before another live change.

continuation.next_static_hypothesis: Division-free equivalent supplied rule in full state, separately frozen under the ongoing session.
continuation.scope: A new static hypothesis is distinct from a qualification triggered by this failed gate.
